ratings.comment: Q's graduate seminar "Families and Poverty" was an insightful and meaningful course! I appreciate when instructors incorporate applied activities, and he excelled at this (my favorite was a class debate). It's clear that Q has a wealth of expertise to learn from, and is committed to student success. Also, he's funny! Classes were always a good time

Q is not a standard professor, but more like a fun camp counselor while still being very educated. He will always have strong connections with people in his classes, and if you ever need to take a class with him as the professor always choose him
Super informative and interesting professing. Few things count toward your final grade

Dr. Riser is a brilliant and personable professor. He makes lectures super interesting and is always open to helping outside of class. Quick and easy response time with strong communication. He is also very understanding and accommodating. I would HIGHLY recommend taking any class that he is teaching.

Professor Riser is an amazing prof who offers really interesting lectures! He's super knowledgeable, very easy to talk to, and gives good feedback. Definitely will take his course CNSR SCI 465 next semester.

Dr. Riser is a fantastic professor. He gives quality feedback and is always ready to support and meet his students' needs. While he is very intelligent and knowledgable, he also is very kind and easy going; it is a pleasure to be one of his students!

Riser is a GREAT prof! He is somewhat new to SoHE. Very understanding, communicative, and funny. Grading criteria was clear, super responsive to emails, and an overall nice guy. I am also a student in his research lab, his work is very interesting. Riser is teaching Families&Poverty in the Spring (asynchronous Fridays).
